dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I ask who you are?

dialogues.speaker: Nobumori
dialogues.text: Hello! Welcome to Komore Teahouse. I am a doorman for the Kamisato Clan, and I work here.

dialogues.speaker: Nobumori
dialogues.text: That being said, I really have nothing better to do than drinking tea here... It's far more relaxed compared to the days when I still had a Vision. It's not bad. Not bad at all.
